title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the scribe on the bridge.

incident_id.title: Incident id
incident_id.description: Which incident is this, by its ticket or PagerDuty id (e.g. INC-2417)?

incident_url.title: Incident URL
incident_url.description: What URL points at the incident ticket or bridge channel?

decided_at.title: Decided at
decided_at.description: When did the commander speak the decision, as an ISO-8601 timestamp with zone?

commander.title: Commander
commander.description: Who made the call — the incident commander or the delegate named on the bridge, as role:handle (e.g. ic:alice)?

executor.title: Executor
executor.description: Who runs the change, as role:handle? Same as the commander if nobody else does.

chosen_option.title: Chosen option
chosen_option.description: What action was chosen and why, in one line?

rejected_option.title: Rejected option
rejected_option.description: What other action was on the table and why was it rejected, in one line?

do_nothing_reason.title: Do-nothing reason
do_nothing_reason.description: Why was waiting and keeping observing rejected (or chosen)?

blast_radius.title: Blast radius
blast_radius.description: Which systems, regions or tenants are affected, and by how much — percent of traffic, requests per minute, customers or revenue per minute?

rollback_metric.title: Rollback metric
rollback_metric.description: Which metric, on which dashboard, decides the rollback?

rollback_threshold.title: Rollback threshold
rollback_threshold.description: At what numeric value of that metric does the rollback run (e.g. above 2%)?

rollback_window.title: Rollback window
rollback_window.description: For how long must the metric stay past the threshold before rolling back (e.g. 5 consecutive minutes)?

rollback_command.title: Rollback command
rollback_command.description: What exact command or runbook URL undoes the mitigation?

dashboard_url.title: Dashboard URL
dashboard_url.description: What dashboard URL, with the incident time range pinned in its query string, shows the system at the moment of the decision?

announcement_url.title: Announcement URL
announcement_url.description: What permalink points at the chat message, alert or commit where the decision was announced?

postmortem_date.title: Postmortem date
postmortem_date.description: On which date is the postmortem, as YYYY-MM-DD? The record is reviewed there.
